v4::en::Runway开源了Python库confingy，旨在解决机器学: Runway open sourced the Python library confingy, aiming to solve the long-term pain points of machine learning system configuration. Confingy can meet core needs such as tracking constructor parameters and avoiding instantiation of expensive objects (such as large language models) without refactoring existing code. It effectively improves development experience problems such as inability to jump to definitions, invalid type hints, and difficulty in refactoring due to complex YAML configurations.

v4::en::现有无评论者RLHF方法通过算术平均聚合多目标奖励，易导致约束忽: Existing reviewer-free RLHF methods aggregate multi-objective rewards through arithmetic averaging, which easily leads to constraint neglect: a high score on a single objective may mask serious failures in other key objectives (such as security or format), thereby hiding low-performance bottleneck rewards that affect reliable alignment. This study proposes Reward Variance Policy Optimization (RVPO), a risk-sensitive framework that penalizes inter-reward variance in advantage aggregation and changes the optimization goal from "maximizing sum" to "maximizing consistency". Analysis shows that RVPO can effectively identify and increase the contribution of bottleneck rewards, and achieve more balanced policy optimization in multi-goal alignment tasks such as security and format compliance.

v4::en::研究人员提出文本条件联合嵌入预测架构（TC-JEPA），通过引入: The researchers proposed the Text Conditional Joint Embedding Prediction Architecture (TC-JEPA) to reduce visual uncertainty in mask feature prediction by introducing image description text as condition information. This method employs a fine-grained text conditioner to compute sparse cross-attention on input text markers to modulate the predicted image patch features. Compared with I-JEPA based on mask feature prediction, TC-JEPA can learn visual representations with richer semantics, solving the problem of insufficient semantic learning caused by visual uncertainty in the original method.
v4::en::研究发现，强化学习改进大语言模型推理时，并非教授新策略，而是对基: Research has found that when reinforcement learning improves large language model reasoning, it does not teach new strategies, but redistributes probabilities for solutions already mastered by the basic model. Its effective impact is only concentrated on 1-3% of high-entropy decision-making tokens, and the improved tokens are always among the top 5 alternatives of the basic model. Based on this, the researchers proposed the ReasonMaxxer method that does not require reinforcement learning. It only applies contrast loss at the decision point of entropy gating, requiring only hundreds of basic model deductions and no need for online generation. In multiple model and mathematical reasoning benchmark tests, this method reaches or exceeds the performance of full reinforcement learning, while training only requires dozens of questions and several minutes of single GPU time, and the cost is reduced by about three orders of magnitude.
v4::en::研究发现，部分已发布的模型存在有限的意外对思维链（CoT）进行评: Research has found that some published models have limited cases of unexpected chain-of-thought (CoT) scoring. This shows that the impact of unexpected scoring on CoT in current reinforcement learning training is limited and does not have a negative impact on monitoring capabilities after repair.
v4::en::研究团队发布IndustryBench，这是一个基于中国国家标准: The research team released IndustryBench, a 2049-item Chinese industrial procurement Q&A benchmark based on Chinese national standards (GB/T) and industrial product records, and provides a multi-language aligned version. During construction, the verification process based on external search rejected 70.3% of large language model generation problems, highlighting the unreliability of model filtering alone. The evaluation of multi-language models found that: the best system score (0-3 point scale) is only 2.083 points, with huge room for improvement; "standards and terminology" are common capability shortcomings; extended reasoning will reduce the security adjustment scores of most models due to the introduction of unfounded security-critical details; security violation inspections will significantly change model rankings. Research shows that large language model evaluation in the industrial field needs to be based on source text and be security-conscious, rather than relying on simple aggregate accuracy.

v5::en::Runway开源了Python库confingy，旨在解决机器学: Runway open sourced the Python library confingy, aiming to solve the long-term pain points of machine learning system configuration. Confingy can meet core needs such as tracking constructor parameters and avoiding instantiation of expensive objects (such as large language models) without refactoring existing code. It effectively improves development experience problems such as inability to jump to definitions, invalid type hints, and difficulty in refactoring due to complex YAML configurations.

v5::en::SimWorld Studio是一个基于Unreal Engin: SimWorld Studio is an open source platform based on Unreal Engine 5, designed to automatically generate dynamically evolving 3D interactive environments for embodied agent learning. Its core is the tool-enhanced coding agent SimCoder, which can write engine code according to instructions to build a physically real world, and evolves itself through verification feedback, corrects the environment, and accumulates reusable skills. The generated environment is exported with a standardized interface for agent training. The platform also realizes the co-evolution of environment generation and agent learning: based on the agent's performance feedback, SimCoder generates adaptive courses near its ability boundaries, so that the difficulty of the environment increases as the agent progresses. In the case of embodied navigation, this solution significantly improves the generalization performance of the agent.

v5::en::吸引子模型解决了循环Transformer训练不稳定、成本高和深: The attractor model solves the problems of unstable, high cost and fixed depth of cyclic Transformer training. It generates the initial output embedding through the backbone module, the attractor module iteratively optimizes the fixed point, and uses implicit differentiation to calculate the gradient, making the training memory independent of the effective depth and adaptive convergence of the iteration number. In language modeling, compared with the standard Transformer, the perplexity is reduced by up to 46.6%, the accuracy of downstream tasks is increased by up to 19.7%, and the training cost is lower; the performance of a 770M parameter model is better than that of the 1.3B parameter Transformer. In the inference task, with only about 1,000 examples, the 27 million parameter model achieved an accuracy of 91.4% and 93.1% on Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Hard, respectively, which is better than leading models such as Claude and GPT o3. The model also exhibits the phenomenon of equilibrium internalization. After training, the initial output embedding is close to the equilibrium state. The solver can be removed during inference with almost no loss in performance, achieving the scalability of iterative optimization.

v5::en::现有无评论者RLHF方法通过算术平均聚合多目标奖励，易导致约束忽: Existing reviewer-free RLHF methods aggregate multi-objective rewards through arithmetic averaging, which easily leads to constraint neglect: a high score on a single objective may mask serious failures in other key objectives (such as security or format), thereby hiding low-performance bottleneck rewards that affect reliable alignment. This study proposes Reward Variance Policy Optimization (RVPO), a risk-sensitive framework that penalizes inter-reward variance in advantage aggregation and changes the optimization goal from "maximizing sum" to "maximizing consistency". Analysis shows that RVPO can effectively identify and increase the contribution of bottleneck rewards, and achieve more balanced policy optimization in multi-goal alignment tasks such as security and format compliance.
v5::en::由伯克利RDI、马克斯·普朗克安全与隐私研究所、Anthropi: A team composed of researchers from Berkeley RDI, the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google released a new benchmark called ExploitGym. The test contains 898 real vulnerabilities and requires the AI ​​agent to generate a complete exploit program based on the vulnerability description. The results show that cutting-edge AI models have been able to successfully exploit a considerable number of vulnerabilities, and some attacks can still succeed even after standard defense measures such as ASLR are enabled. This proves that AI has the ability to autonomously transform vulnerabilities into actual attacks. This technology has a dual purpose: it can not only help defenders assess the severity of vulnerabilities, but also potentially lower the technical threshold of attackers.
v5::en::研究团队发布IndustryBench，这是一个基于中国国家标准: The research team released IndustryBench, a 2049-item Chinese industrial procurement Q&A benchmark based on Chinese national standards (GB/T) and industrial product records, and provides a multi-language aligned version. During construction, the verification process based on external search rejected 70.3% of large language model generation problems, highlighting the unreliability of model filtering alone. The evaluation of multi-language models found that: the best system score (0-3 point scale) is only 2.083 points, with huge room for improvement; "standards and terminology" are common capability shortcomings; extended reasoning will reduce the security adjustment scores of most models due to the introduction of unfounded security-critical details; security violation inspections will significantly change model rankings. Research shows that large language model evaluation in the industrial field needs to be based on source text and be security-conscious, rather than relying on simple aggregate accuracy.

v5::en::针对LLM多智能体系统在长程任务中因关键错误扩散导致整体失败的问: Aiming at the problem of overall failure of the LLM multi-agent system due to the proliferation of critical errors in long-distance tasks, this study proposes the online audit framework AgentForesight. The research constructed the AFTraj-2K trajectory corpus, and developed the AgentForesight-7B model based on this. The model is trained using a coarse-to-fine reinforcement learning strategy. v5::en::针对离散流匹配生成文本需数百步迭代的问题，本研究提出轨迹塑形离散: Aiming at the problem that generating text through discrete flow matching requires hundreds of iterations, this study proposes a trajectory shaping discrete flow matching method. This process only increases the training cost. In the 170 million-parameter language modeling task, the shaped 8-step student model was 32% less perplexed and 128 times faster than the 1024-step teacher model, and performed consistently across different data and model sizes. This method achieves the best perplexity over all compared baselines, including those using more data or larger models.

A team composed of researchers from Berkeley RDI, the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google released a new benchmark called ExploitGym. The test contains 898 real vulnerabilities and requires the AI ​​agent to generate a complete exploit program based on the vulnerability description. The results show that cutting-edge AI models have been able to successfully exploit a considerable number of vulnerabilities, and some attacks can still succeed even after standard defense measures such as ASLR are enabled. This proves that AI has the ability to autonomously transform vulnerabilities into actual attacks. This technology has a dual purpose: it can not only help defenders assess the severity of vulnerabilities, but also potentially lower the technical threshold of attackers. .
